description: Test whether loss of the yeast adaptor interface is specific to FIS-2 or shared by human FIS1
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
d=pd.read_csv("fis2_interface_mapping.csv")
d["burial"]=d[["Mdv1_2PQN_atomcontacts","Caf4_2PQR_atomcontacts","Mdv1_3UUX_atomcontacts"]].max(axis=1)

def aa(s):  # "F38" -> "F", "-" -> None
    s=str(s)
    return None if s in("-","nan") else s[0]
for c in ["FIS-2 (Ce)","FIS-1 (Ce)","FIS1 (Hs)"]:
    d[c+"_aa"]=d[c].map(aa)
d["y"]=d["yeast_res"]

# Q1: is the loss of the yeast adaptor interface specific to FIS-2, or general to metazoan Fis1?
print("Identity to yeast Fis1 at the 47 adaptor-contact positions")
rows=[]
for c in ["FIS1 (Hs)","FIS-1 (Ce)","FIS-2 (Ce)"]:
    sub=d[d[c+"_aa"].notna()]
    for face in ["N-arm","concave","convex","loop","ALL"]:
        s=sub if face=="ALL" else sub[sub.face==face]
        n=len(s); k=int((s[c+"_aa"]==s.y).sum())
        rows.append((c,face,k,n,k/n if n else np.nan))
ident=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["protein","face","identical","aligned","frac"])
print(ident.to_string(index=False))

# high-burial hotspots
hb=d[d.burial>=15]
print("\nHigh-burial contacts (>=15 atoms), n =",len(hb))
for c in ["FIS1 (Hs)","FIS-1 (Ce)","FIS-2 (Ce)"]:
    s=hb[hb[c+"_aa"].notna()]
    print(f"  {c}: {int((s[c+'_aa']==s.y).sum())}/{len(s)} identical to yeast")
print(hb[["yeast_pos","yeast_res","face","burial","FIS1 (Hs)","FIS-1 (Ce)","FIS-2 (Ce)"]].to_string(index=False))

# Q2: does FIS-2 match HUMAN FIS1 at these positions better than it matches yeast?
pair=d[d["FIS1 (Hs)_aa"].notna() & d["FIS-2 (Ce)_aa"].notna()]
k=int((pair["FIS-2 (Ce)_aa"]==pair["FIS1 (Hs)_aa"]).sum())
print(f"\nFIS-2 vs human FIS1 at shared contact positions: {k}/{len(pair)} = {k/len(pair):.3f}")
kc=pair[pair.face=="concave"]; print(f"   concave only: {int((kc['FIS-2 (Ce)_aa']==kc['FIS1 (Hs)_aa']).sum())}/{len(kc)}")

# Q3: 2x2 test, is FIS-2 better preserved at concave contacts than human FIS1 is?
a=ident.set_index(["protein","face"])
tab=[[int(a.loc[("FIS-2 (Ce)","concave"),"identical"]),int(a.loc[("FIS-2 (Ce)","concave"),"aligned"])-int(a.loc[("FIS-2 (Ce)","concave"),"identical"])],
     [int(a.loc[("FIS1 (Hs)","concave"),"identical"]),int(a.loc[("FIS1 (Hs)","concave"),"aligned"])-int(a.loc[("FIS1 (Hs)","concave"),"identical"])]]
orr,p=stats.fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"\nFisher, concave identity to yeast, FIS-2 vs human FIS1: table={tab} OR={orr:.3f} p={p:.3f}")

d.to_csv("fis2_adaptor_contacts_final.csv",index=False)
ident.to_csv("fis2_identity_by_face.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
faces=["N-arm","concave","convex","loop"]
prots=["FIS1 (Hs)","FIS-1 (Ce)","FIS-2 (Ce)"]
cols=["#888888","#2c6fbb","#b03030"]
x=np.arange(len(faces)); w=0.26
for i,(pr,c) in enumerate(zip(prots,cols)):
    v=[float(a.loc[(pr,f),"frac"]) for f in faces]
    nn=[f"{int(a.loc[(pr,f),'identical'])}/{int(a.loc[(pr,f),'aligned'])}" for f in faces]
    b=ax[0].bar(x+(i-1)*w,v,w,color=c,label=pr)
    for bb,t in zip(b,nn): ax[0].text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,bb.get_height()+0.012,t,ha="center",fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_xticks(x);ax[0].set_xticklabels(faces);ax[0].set_ylim(0,0.6)
ax[0].set_ylabel("fraction identical to S. cerevisiae Fis1")
ax[0].set_title("A  Adaptor-contact residues are not preserved in any animal Fis1",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)

hbs=hb.sort_values("burial",ascending=False)
yy=np.arange(len(hbs))[::-1]
ax[1].barh(yy,hbs.burial,color=["#2c6fbb" if f=="concave" else "#c0702a" if f=="N-arm" else "#5a8f3d" if f=="convex" else "#999999" for f in hbs.face])
lab=[f"{r.yeast_res}{r.yeast_pos} ({r.face})  ->  Ce FIS-2 {r['FIS-2 (Ce)']}" for _,r in hbs.iterrows()]
ax[1].set_yticks(yy);ax[1].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=7.5)
for y_,r in zip(yy,hbs.itertuples()):
    same=getattr(r,"_12")==r.yeast_res if False else (r.y==str(getattr(r,"_11"))[0] if False else None)
for y_,(_,r) in zip(yy,hbs.iterrows()):
    ok = r["FIS-2 (Ce)_aa"]==r.y
    ax[1].text(r.burial+0.6,y_,"retained" if ok else "lost",va="center",fontsize=7.5,
               color="#2e7d32" if ok else "#b03030",fontweight="bold" if ok else "normal")
ax[1].set_xlabel("max heavy-atom contacts with Mdv1/Caf4 in 2PQN, 2PQR, 3UUX")
ax[1].set_xlim(0,46)
ax[1].set_title("B  Buried adaptor hotspots and their FIS-2 equivalents",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
